Question: Who are our top sellers?
text:
```sql
SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items AS oi
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
This query lists the seller IDs with the highest total sales revenue, ordered from highest to lowest.
